metadata.name: js
metadata.description: kind "js" — JS source (last expression must be a callable) → runtime Fn via QuickJS-emscripten (a JS-in-wasm sandbox). new Function removed (wasm-only-functions): no DOM, no eval, no host APIs unless granted via the host segment. Lazy-loads the ~1MB runtime on first compile.
Bootstrap switch. Lazy: the QuickJS runtime (~1MB) loads on first js cel compile. Defaults true.
Runtime-ready sentinel. Stays true at boot (lazy-load masks the transition); v2 with explicit lifecycle will flip false→true at runtime spawn.
Catastrophic-death sentinel. Main-thread QuickJS doesn't crash without taking the process down; trivially true. Becomes meaningful with worker isolation.
Append-only log of CelError values produced by js lambdas. v1: empty array.
